item.question: What does cytokinesis divide?
item.explanation: After mitosis, cytokinesis divides the cytoplasm into two separate daughter cells.

evidence.quote: After mitosis, cytokinesis takes place. This is the division of the cytoplasm, producing two separate daughter cells.

item.question: In your own words: what is mitosis good for?
item.answer: It lets organisms grow, replaces old or damaged cells and helps with healing; in single-celled organisms it is how they reproduce.
item.explanation: Mitosis lets multicellular organisms grow and repair themselves.

evidence.quote: Mitosis is essential for growth and development, allowing multicellular organisms to increase their number of cells.

item.question: Each daughter cell is genetically {{identical}} to the parent cell.

evidence.quote: Each daughter cell is genetically identical to the parent cell, with the same number of chromosomes.
